title: Reproduction package: unsupervised and semi-supervised anomaly detection for credit card fraud under chronological evaluation
description:
Revision pipeline (v2) for the manuscript Unsupervised and Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection for Credit Card Fraud: A Chronological Benchmark and a Hybrid Bridge to Supervised Learning (Array, manuscript ARRAY-D-26-04414, under revision).

Five classical anomaly detectors (Isolation Forest, LOF, One-Class SVM, DBSCAN, K-Means) are benchmarked on two public fraud datasets (ULB creditcard.csv and PaySim) under a leakage-free chronological protocol. The package documents the points raised in review: explicit out-of-sample scoring interfaces for LOF (novelty=True) and for DBSCAN (distance to the nearest training core point), decision thresholds fitted on the validation split and applied unchanged to the chronological test stream, and three named fitting regimes (U label-free, N normal-only, O oracle) that keep label-derived quantities out of label-free claims. The scripts of the submitted version are included unmodified for auditability. The datasets are not redistributed; download links are given in the README.
